records.rule: Money is exact whole-number minor units under NUMERIC DIGITS 50.
records.guard_order: establish numeric digits 50 before the whole-number guard and before DATATYPE(...,'W')
records.incident: 12,000,000,000 exact-minor-unit transaction mis-evaluated under an inadequate arithmetic context until the order was fixed.

records.rule: Never emit or persist money as a JSON number; use I:<digits> with an S: storage layer on the wire.
records.reason: json.cls can reclassify numeric-looking Rexx strings as JSON numbers; S: preserves opaque leading-zero identifiers and evidence references.

records.rule: Settlement rounding and tax determination rounding are separate decisions; a settlement adjustment never rewrites the previously determined tax amount.
records.dispatch: policy selected by exact rulesetIdentity frozen in an effective-dated election, never by domicile or mutable defaults

records.rule: Exact replay of a completed transaction returns DUPLICATE; changed reuse of the same source identity is SOURCE_*_EVENT_CONFLICT before policy dispatch.
records.note: restart resolves reuse against the durable journal, not blind re-execution

records.rule: A later or superseding figure adds bound lifecycle observations; it never rewrites what was actually approved or filed.
records.lineage: ORIGINAL/AMENDMENT/CORRECTION with exact predecessor fingerprint binding

records.rule: An intentionally omitted statement is evidence of omission, never coerced to zero; never invent a figure the filing did not deliver.
records.companion: a filed-accounts import never posts to the native GL

records.rule: Reporting can span multiple legal entities while retaining each line's exact legal-entity/book identity; it is not consolidation by fiat.
records.note: distinguish INTER_ESTABLISHMENT from INTERCOMPANY; do not infer legal entities from places of business

records.rule: Persistence is append-only JSONL; one store holds one accounting book for one legal entity; recovery rebuilds the source index before policy dispatch.
